qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and bounded production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.operation: long-mode qword unsigned accumulator MUL from scalar memory immediately followed by qword register-to-memory MOV
admission.callbacks: restartable scalar read followed by transactional scalar write
admission.ordering: the MUL source is staged from the old register image before RDX:RAX publication; the following store materializes flags before borrowing lazy-payload words for its address and value
admission.boundedRule: The memory store is admissible only as the immediate successor of a qword memory-source accumulator MUL in the same block.
admission.deferred: standalone and narrower memory stores, narrower memory-source accumulator MUL, signed accumulator multiply, divide, and atomic or locked memory read-modify-write forms

verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,438 tests in 171 suites passed; one pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent
verification.differentialCoverage: The exact 12-byte measured pair and RAX/RDX address-aliasing variants match the interpreter in architectural state and memory.
verification.rollbackCoverage: A failed MUL-source read and a failed following store both preserve the original architectural state and memory.
verification.negativeAdmissionCoverage: Standalone qword stores, dword memory-source MUL, and dword stores after qword MUL remain tier-one declines.

rejectedBroadAdmissionDiagnostic.status: correctness-passing experiment rejected for excessive production scope
rejectedBroadAdmissionDiagnostic.interpretation: The broad qword-store rule completed correctly but changed tens of thousands of dynamically observed admission decisions beyond the one measured block. Dynamic totals are unmatched-run diagnostics, not a performance or exact site-count comparison. Production retains only the immediate MUL/store pair.

unmatchedFullRunComparison.interpretation: The single sequential full runs differ in dynamic instruction, interrupt, compilation, and trace totals. This direction is reassuring but is not a matched or statistical performance claim.

interpretation: The exact measured memory-MUL/store pair now executes as one restartable tier-one block, disappears from the bounded full-run negative cache, and completes the authenticated seven-workload userspace run. The follow-up boundary prevents the generic qword-store admission exposed by the broad diagnostic run. A05.2 remains open because 125,548 of 224,433 full-run tier-one attempts still declined.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one bounded candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The broad and bounded runs are unmatched dynamic executions and do not establish a performance delta or an exact count of extra static sites.
The hot-site sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list, not from every historical cache entry.
The diagnostic runner marks every record releaseQualified=false; this evidence does not satisfy G1-G5.
